svg.title: Mystic Minigolf (2024 – 2025)
svg.desc: Mystic Minigolf, 2024 to 2025: VR minigolf on a temple island, Unity and C#.
svg.text: virtual reality · built as a pair · ENSIM
VR minigolf on an island of ancient temples, where an animated mascot demonstrates the
swing before you strike the ball, club in hand.
Two scenes and three courses, all playable to the end.
